features.name: Prompt and workflow library
features.detail: Team-scoped prompts and multi-step workflows with append-only versions, private/team visibility, owner/admin-only edits and deletes, credential-looking text rejected, strict single-pass {param} rendering (values never re-expand), render never starts a run. No web UI for authoring; no sharing across teams by design.

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts and command palette
features.state: VERIFIED IMPLEMENTED (local, tested in real Chromium)
features.detail: ARIA combobox/listbox palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K), ranked matching, chord parsing, conflict/reserved-chord validation, focus trap and focus restore, direct command chords. Not yet mounted into the app shell: NEEDS INTEGRATION (shell owner supplies the command list).

features.name: Accessibility
features.state: PARTIAL (automated axe WCAG 2.x A/AA + keyboard tests on the new surfaces only)
features.detail: axe-core found and the fixes removed: kbd contrast inside the active option; the page-has-heading-one hit was a harness gap. Clean in en/es/ar, palette open and closed. Automated rules cover only a fraction of WCAG: no screen-reader testing, no zoom/reflow audit, and pre-existing section7 screens were not audited.

features.name: Internationalisation and timezone
features.state: PARTIAL (3 locales on the new surfaces; timezone formatting verified)
features.detail: en/es/ar catalogs with enforced key and placeholder parity, English fallback, RTL direction, Intl timezone formatting (DST-day case, invalid zone -> UTC, bad input never fabricated). Only the inbox, palette and status strings are translated; the rest of the app is English-only. Translations are machine-authored and NEED human review.

features.name: Status page
features.state: PARTIAL (authenticated component status; no public page, no incident history)
features.detail: GET /status probes each configured upstream's /health with a 3s timeout and reports operational/degraded/not_configured/unreachable honestly; the /health path convention is assumed and NEEDS EXTERNAL VALIDATION against the real upstreams. No incident log or subscriptions.

features.name: Run-linked feedback
features.state: VERIFIED IMPLEMENTED (local); linking to runs outside this lane NEEDS INTEGRATION
features.detail: Thumbs + comment linked to a session or a run id this lane has seen, team-scoped, comment control-stripped and credential-scrubbed, one entry per user per link (upsert; a NULL-vs-UNIQUE duplicate bug was found by test and fixed). Engineers/admins read team feedback, others only their own. Runs not started through this lane cannot be linked until the orchestrator is consulted.

risks.note: Library, palette and templates reduce repeat effort; no usability measurement.
Run-linked feedback gives a signal channel; no data collected, no analysis.
CLI from S4; no library/feedback CLI commands yet.
Status page makes dependency failure visible; probes unvalidated against real upstreams.
Library and feedback reject/scrub credential-looking text.
Rendered library text is data; strict placeholders prevent value re-expansion; no run is started by rendering.
Automated a11y checks on new surfaces only; real assistive-technology testing not done.
